title: Domain Tecnaria connector

sourceOracles.coverage: TecnariaConnector construction, catalog resolution, inheritance and normalized connector properties; direct serialization, defaults and error parity are covered by the independent live test

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript TecnariaConnector classes, including exact unit-normalized JSON, numerical connector properties, Unicode, defaults, inherited instanceof boundaries, clone isolation and unsupported/error paths.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact JSON serialization for normalized connector, metadata and inherited fields
tolerances.numericParity: exact equality for normalized Kser, Ku, Fvrk and board thickness
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality

parityDifferences: The slice preserves the source TecnariaConnector defaults, catalog-unit conversion, generated name, metadata, inheritance, serialization, direct type and numeric board-thickness properties, and unsupported/error behavior.
createTecnariaConnector and additional connector, material and application functionality remain outside this bounded slice.
engineeringFunctionality: Generic Tecnaria connector construction from the migrated catalog only; no connector factory or verification is introduced.
